relationships.subject: Casgevy
relationships.evidence_quote: By reducing BCL11A expression, Casgevy increases levels of fetal haemoglobin.

relationships.subject: BCL11A
relationships.evidence_quote: which encodes a transcription factor that mediates the switch from production of fetal haemoglobin to adult haemoglobin

key_findings: Primer on CRISPR technologies (DSB editing, base/prime editing, CRISPRa/i, RNA editing), delivery and off-target safety for anaesthesiologists.
Casgevy targets the BCL11A erythroid enhancer to raise fetal haemoglobin.
